about_item: 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐡 𝐀𝐮𝐝𝐢𝐨 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐂𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐫 𝐂𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐬:These open-ear wireless Bluetooth headphones feature an innovative quad-speaker design (dual drivers per earbud), equipped with 15mm large-diaphragm dynamic drivers and a dedicated headphone amplifier chip. The primary drivers are precisely aligned with your ear canal to deliver live-concert-quality audio with stunning immersion.

𝐎𝐩𝐞𝐧 𝐄𝐚𝐫 𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐋𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐰𝐞𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭: The OHAYO T10 open ear headphones weigh only 8 grams per earbud—lighter than a standard key—for a weightless feel. The open-ear design enhances safety by keeping you aware of your surroundings and reduces ear canal friction, cutting skin irritation by 𝟗𝟎% compared to in-ear models. Perfect for 10+ hours of continuous use without discomfort.

𝟒𝟎-𝐇𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐏𝐥𝐚𝐲𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞 𝐏𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐫: These Bluetooth 5.4 open ear earbuds offer 𝟏𝟎 𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐬 of playtime, plus 𝟑𝟎 𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐬 from the charging case—totaling 40 hours. That’s 𝟔𝟎𝟎 𝐬𝐨𝐧𝐠𝐬 or 𝟏𝟔 𝐦𝐨𝐯𝐢𝐞𝐬 on one charge, perfect for long trips without frequent recharging.

𝐈𝐏𝐗6 𝐖𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐨𝐟 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐄𝐚𝐫𝐡𝐨𝐨𝐤𝐬 𝐃𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐠𝐧: These over-ear earbuds with Bluetooth 5.4 deliver 2x faster transmission speeds and rock-solid connectivity. The ergonomic ear hooks provide a secure fit that stays put even during intense workouts. With an IPX6 rating, they effectively repel sweat, rain, and splashes, rigorously tested to endure 100+ hours of active use - making these over-ear earbuds the perfect choice for high-intensity training and outdoor adventures.

𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐮𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐓𝐨𝐮𝐜𝐡: Featuring an intelligent button design, these wireless Bluetooth earbuds allow quick call answering/ending with just a fingertip press. The innovative multi-function single-button control enables effortless management of music and calls. Whether commuting, exercising, or running outdoors, enjoy a seamlessly convenient and secure operating experience with these premium wireless earbuds.

summary.text: Customers find these headphones offer good sound quality with balanced highs and bass, and appreciate their comfort, with one noting they're gentle on the ears. The earbuds fit snugly and stay in place, and they work well for music and phone calls, connecting easily to phones. Customers consider them good value for money and praise their quality. Battery life receives mixed reviews, with some finding it impressive while others report charging issues.
